title: 澳大利亚中华道教协会贺信
title_en: Australian Chinese Taoist Association Congratulatory Letter
body: 澳大利亚中华道教协会发来贺信，祝愿协会蓬勃发展，促进道教文化在海外的传播。
body_en: The Australian Chinese Taoist Association sent congratulations, wishing the association prosperity and promoting the spread of Taoist culture overseas.
